author: Mango_
body:
Hi everyone! This is my submission for Event #10 - Pluto. The name of this map is Barren Creek and was made with melee PvP in mind. The mountain ranges surrounding the map prevent players being knocked into the void. Barren Creek will most likely support 16 players, however I may reduce it to 8 if need be. There are four main quadrants with potential spawn points, and four intersection points branching out from the middle summit. Please let me know what you think, and feel free to leave any suggestions you may have. Thanks!

Gamemode: FFA (Free for All)
Creator: Mango_

Loadout:
- Iron Sword
- Bow with 16 arrows
- 3x golden apples
- 16x cooked steak
- Leather armour with iron boots

Images :: Download :: YML

replies.author: PokerFace
replies.body:
Hi Mango_,

I'm sorry to say that your map cannot be entered as a contest submission due to it breaking Rule #7 where you cannot submit maps made prior to the contest announcement. However, you are more then welcome to submit this map as a regular FFA map and/or make another FFA map for the contest. There is still about 2 more weeks for the contest which should be plenty of time to build a map. Again, I'm really sorry about the inconvenience. Good luck!

Regards,
PokerFace
Avicus Build Contest Judge

*The map looks pretty good. Especially the unique glowstone pattern.
